notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
The Journal has been reworked: 
[list]
[*] detailed task lists have been added for each mission.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*] Added key hint.
[*] New jump animation.
[*] Added translation into Indonesian.
[*] Added translation into Ukrainian.
[/list]
 
Fixed:
[list]
[*] On some graphics settings plants were visible through the walls of buildings.
[*] The screen resolution selection menu was too long.
[*] Texts were too small on high resolution displays.
[*] The mouse rotation speed was insufficient for some users.
[*] Some menus could not be closed using Esc.
[*] Characters' faces were too bright.
[/list]

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
1) Corrected inaccuracies in the text.
2) Fixed the potion list in the inventory: now all potions mentioned in dialogues are opened, even if they are not available.
3) New enemies appear more evenly throughout the game.
4) Capturing ingredients when concocting a potion has been improved.
5) Minor balance changes.
6) Added pictures for several achievements.
7) Corrected description of few ingredients.
8) Performance optimization.
9) Added the spawn animation for skeletons.
10) Added Thai, Vietnamese and Turkish languages.
11) New ScrollBars.
12) Accelerated health recovery when there are no enemies in the world.
13) Fixed the characters' look direction.
